title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF advanced child protection by strengthening legal frameworks, supporting digitalization, and providing technical assistance for policy development and training. Key efforts included empowering adolescent mothers through parenting programs, enhancing juvenile correctional services, and promoting multi-sector collaboration to prevent violence against children and build sustainable, protective environments.;;
